<!-- wg-report cycle=2026-10-29 group=wg:third-party-ready -->
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-10-28 11:30 to 2026-10-29 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: none new. No item outside the role's boundary was stopped on this cycle.
Still waiting on you with no ruling: needs-input issues srs-rust#1380, #1198, #1132, srs#928 (and parked srs-rust#683, #704); the three open exercises (6b).

2. Decided within mandate: nothing ratified by the group this cycle; no proposed decision had assent on a merged PR, so no group session was held. Owner act this cycle: you merged srs-rust#1497 (note delete refuses a note that Relations point at, unless `--cascade`) on 10-28 17:22, which is option A, my recommendation on escalation c7a8e0a2. The decision record is still `proposed`; see 5b.

3. Done: 15 group PRs merged this cycle, all by you from the owner account (merges are not by the group). Quorum comments (builder agent:tpr-builder / reviewer agent:tpr-reviewer) are present on srs#979, #980, srs-rust#1506, #1511, #1481, #1497; srs-rust#1507 carries a challenger review (local session) approve with no builder/reviewer/mandate line.
- Rulings and mandate-bearing: srs-rust#1511 (each definition version written beside the others, mandate owner-layout-2026-10-25 / srs-rust#1473); srs-rust#1506 (optional stable code on validation diagnostics, decision bf4a5af5); srs-rust#1481 (RFC-043 arrangement fixture, ruling c16c70c1); srs-rust#1497 (note delete, see 2); srs#979 and srs#980 (RFC-043 arrangement scenarios, mandate RFC-043 / charter 00567bf1).
- Other: srs-rust#1514 (type name resolves to its latest version), #1507 (migration revision step in the listing); srs#986 (srs-usage revisionStep), srs#984 (srs-spec.md normative only), srs#981 (arrangement scenarios; its last recorded review was a reject on red `pr-classification`, later merged), srs#988 (spec as fetch-sized agent pages and llms.txt; gate:owner-merge, reviewer escalated a new gate); srs-rust#1518, #1519, #1520 (prebuilt releases, engine.semanticops.com, cross target), no wg quorum comments seen on these.

4. Stuck or lost: 3 group PRs open (the 11:30 `group-state` read).
- srs-rust#1487 (refuse field/type updates that would invalidate records, #1484): merge conflict (dirty) and a red `Test` on head 2eb1c3b; the reviewer rejected it 10-28 18:41 and voided the earlier quorum. Nothing pushed since. Needs the builder.
- srs#990 (llms.txt opens with Get running): clean, gate:owner-merge, waits on you.
- srs-programme#305 (proposed decision on the arrangement fixture and container-literal allowlist, srs#977): behind base since 10-27, no quorum comment yet. Two days with no movement.
Merged PRs with no quorum line (srs#984, #986, srs-rust#1514, #1518, #1519, #1520; srs#988 has only a reject): the quorum record is incomplete for them.

5. Budget: delegated merges this cycle by `clerk group-state`: 0 of 10 (the cycle rolled over at 11:30; counted from the PRs: 7 carried gate:auto-merge, 8 did not and were merged by you), 3 open, room 7. Pause state: ok (running). Last two group reports (10-27, 10-28) both have a 👍, not paused.
5b. Awaiting ratification: c7a8e0a2 (note delete escalation, age 1 day; you merged the PR, the record still reads proposed); the proposed decision inside srs-programme#305 once it merges. Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: queue fed. Open issues labelled `ready` + `wg:third-party-ready` with no needs-input and not parked: 12 (srs-rust#1496, #1495, #1492, #1491, #1342, #1339, #861; srs#931, #911, #236; srs-vscode#155; srs-web#632). Some may already be served by merged work (srs-rust#1342 by #1499/#1498 earlier; srs#911 by decision 444121a6; srs-web#638 just closed): not checked. No local priorities set. Top 3 in the Builder's order: srs#236 (P0), srs-rust#861 (P1), srs-rust#1339 (P2, oldest at 10-08, tied with srs-rust#1342 and srs#911). Open group PRs in flight: 3; budget left 7. Queue fed for about 1 cycle (12 ready divided by 10). Waits on you: the merge of srs#990, the four needs-input issues above, the c7a8e0a2 ratification. Fed by the analyst: 2026-10-27 12:28 run (queue fed, 11 filed); no newer run seen.
6b. Exercises: three open, none listed in the SemanticOps log. dd1a47a7 "Relation reads hide who asserted a link" (input: should relation list and context reads carry createdBy, notes and meta, srs-rust#1411); 2ac083c0 "One unknown key makes a whole repository unloadable" (non-fatal diagnostic or fail-closed); 7131fe89 "Substrate entries: the spec contract and the schemas disagree on what a lifecycle state and a relation type must carry" (input line not read). Build trigger: the group log holds well over 10 ratified decisions, so srs-web#560 is still ready to unpark; your call.

7. What we learned: you merged 15 group PRs in one cycle yourself, 4 of them after the reviewer's last word was a reject or an escalation (srs#981 red classification, srs-rust#1481 and #1497 escalations, srs#988 new gate); the delegated budget went unused (0 of 10), which suggests the review-then-auto-merge path is not what lands work, and the quorum record lags the merge. Two more PRs from the release/site work (srs-rust#1518-#1520) landed with no group quorum at all. I1 (measurement abdd5bd3, window from 2026-10-29 11:30 to now): 1 of 3 merged PRs grounded to a problem (33%), 0 of 3 with an affirmed persona and domain (0%); by level none 0, issue 2, problem 1, problem+persona+domain 0; whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
